identity.name: Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd
alt_names: Sultanate of Nejd and Kingdom of Hejaz

land.text: the Hejaz: 'on 19 December 1925, the Kingdom of Hejaz surrendered to the forces of Ibn Saud'; 'On January 8, 1926, he was crowned king in the Masjid al-Haram in Mecca'

predecessors.note: The kingdom-of-hejaz dossier ends in December 1925 and names this state as a successor.

land.text: the Sultanate of Nejd and its dependencies, from which Ibn Saud conquered the Hejaz

predecessors.note: The third-saudi-state dossier (Emirate of Riyadh 1902, Sultanate of Nejd 1921) ends in January 1926 and names this state as the one it merged into.

land.text: the whole realm: 'On 23 September 1932, Ibn Saud proclaimed the union of his dominions into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia'

successors.note: No territory changed with the new name; the kingdom-of-saudi-arabia dossier starts on 23 September 1932 and has its own keyframe for 1932-1935 on this row's 1932 shape. Cliopatria starts its Saudi row only in 1936.

capitals.name: Riyadh
capitals.note: The Kingdom page's capital field is not legible in the text returned; it names Riyadh as the city Ibn Saud captured on 13 January 1902. Riyadh is the seat as the kingdom-of-saudi-arabia dossier has it from 1932; the king was crowned at Mecca and the Hejaz was ruled from Mecca and Jeddah, which no page opened confirms.

rulers.name: Abdulaziz Ibn Saud (Abdul Aziz bin Abdul Rahman)
rulers.title: King of the Hejaz and Sultan (from 1927 King) of Nejd
rulers.note: Crowned King of the Hejaz on 8 January 1926; 'he elevated Nejd to the status of a kingdom on 29 January 1927'.

minus.text: the Emirate of Asir, the 'Southern Territory' of the Saudi realm, 378 cells in Cliopatria's Asir row

correction.text: the 1926 shape without the Emirate of Asir for 1926-1929: Asir came 'under Ibn Saud's direct control' only after a 1930 treaty; holds 1926 to 1929

keyframe_review.note: 1926-1931, 1,622,694 km2: the Hejaz of 1925 (762 cells), the Emirate of Nejd of 1925 (4,049 cells) and about 1,540 more cells of the interior and Asir (all 378 cells of Cliopatria's Asir row). Neither page gives an area, so no ratio could be taken. The Unification page has Asir under Saudi control only 'following a 1930 treaty which provided for the territory to come under Ibn Saud's direct control', so the cut for 1926-1929 is made (the asir dossier of this group dates Saudi suzerainty to 1926 from a page not opened here).

correction.text: the full 1926 shape, Asir included: 'a 1930 treaty which provided for the territory to come under Ibn Saud's direct control'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the Asir cells return to the direct shape in 1930 (the asir dossier dates the incorporation to 20 November 1930). The Kingdom page says only that a 'Southern Territory' was annexed before 1932.

correction.text: the 1926 shape, Asir included since 1930, without the 140 cells Cliopatria adds in 1932 (Najran and the frontier strip north of 17.4 N): 'The Saudis captured the disputed cities of Hajara and Najran on 7 and 21 April' 1934 and 'Treaty of Taif signed on 14 June 1934: Jizan, Asir, and Najran become provinces of Saudi Arabia'; holds 1932 until 23 September, when the realm becomes the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (kingdom-of-saudi-arabia_1932 should take this shape too until 1934)

keyframe_review.note: 1932-1935 in Cliopatria, 1,653,414 km2, 140 cells (35,000 km2: 125 in Saudi Arabia, 11 in Yemen, 4 elsewhere) more than 1926 and 8 fewer. Adjusted after review: 126 of the added cells lie in Cliopatria's North Yemen 1931 shape (Najran and the frontier strip, 17.1-19.1 N), and the Saudi-Yemeni war page (re-read 2026-10-25) shows Najran was 'disputed' and taken by the Saudis on 21 April 1934 and ceded by the Treaty of Taif on 14 June 1934 ('In November 1933, the Yemenis declared war and advanced on Najran'), so the corrected 1932 shape is the 1926 shape. The Kingdom page: 'On September 23, 1932, Abdulaziz proclaimed the union of al-Hasa, Qatif, Nejd, and the Hejaz as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia'. Routed to the kingdom-of-saudi-arabia and north-yemen authors: the 1932-1935 Saudi keyframe should exclude Najran until April 1934 and north-yemen's 1932 loss should move to 1934.

region.text: the Emirate of Asir, the 'Southern Territory' of the Saudi realm, 378 cells in Cliopatria's Asir row

ledger.note: 1926: Asir under Saudi suzerainty. The Saudi-Yemeni war (1934) page: 'In 1926, the Emir of Asir assented to Saudi suzerainty, and in 1930 it was incorporated into the Nejd and Hejaz Kingdom.' (Reviewer me-10-h: source and confidence 1 -> 3 from that page; the Unification page has only the 1930 treaty.)

region.text: the Hejaz and the Sultanate of Nejd under one crown: 'On January 8, 1926, he was crowned king in the Masjid al-Haram in Mecca'

ledger.note: 8 January 1926: Ibn Saud is crowned King of the Hejaz at Mecca and joins it to his Sultanate of Nejd. 'on 19 December 1925, the Kingdom of Hejaz surrendered to the forces of Ibn Saud'; Cliopatria's shape begins in 1926 and the Unification page has 'in 1926, Abdulaziz was proclaimed king of Hejaz'. The Asir cells are left to the vassal event below. Reviewer (me-10-h): counterpart set to third-saudi-state, the Sultanate of Nejd that took the Hejaz in December 1925 and whose dossier ends with a dissolve into this kingdom in January 1926 (the Kingdom page: 'Abdulaziz (Ibn Saud), the Sultan of Nejd, was crowned King of the Hejaz'); kingdom-of-hejaz itself ends 1925-12.

29 January 1927: Nejd becomes a kingdom, and the realm is the Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd. 'he elevated Nejd to the status of a kingdom on 29 January 1927'; the Treaty of Jeddah of 20 May 1927 saw the United Kingdom recognise the realm, 'addressed as the Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd'. No territory changed.

region.text: the Emirate of Asir, the 'Southern Territory' of the Saudi realm, 378 cells in Cliopatria's Asir row

ledger.note: 1930: the suzerainty ends in incorporation. The page: 'following a 1930 treaty which provided for the territory to come under Ibn Saud's direct control'; the asir dossier dates it to 20 November 1930 and the Unification page adds that the Emirate 'was eventually incorporated into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1934'.

region.text: the Emirate of Asir, the 'Southern Territory' of the Saudi realm, 378 cells in Cliopatria's Asir row

ledger.note: 1930: Asir comes under Ibn Saud's direct control. 'following a 1930 treaty which provided for the territory to come under Ibn Saud's direct control'; the Kingdom page's 'Southern Territory' annexed 'before 1932' is the same land. Najran and Jizan became Saudi provinces after the war of 1934 (Unification page).

region.text: the whole realm: 'the union of al-Hasa, Qatif, Nejd, and the Hejaz'

ledger.note: 23 September 1932: Ibn Saud proclaims the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. 'On September 23, 1932, Abdulaziz proclaimed the union of al-Hasa, Qatif, Nejd, and the Hejaz as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia'; 'On 23 September 1932, Ibn Saud proclaimed the union of his dominions into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia' (Unification page). The state continues under the new name; its dossier is kingdom-of-saudi-arabia.

wars.name: Ikhwan Revolt
wars.outcome: The rebellion, which climaxed in a battle at Sabillah, spread through Jabal Shammar in 1929 and 'was put down in 1930, with the surrender of last opposition elements'.
wars.note: No territory changed hands; the page gives no start year for the revolt and no boundary for the rebel-held ground.

certainty.note: Desert frontiers. The Kuwait frontier is the exception: set at the Uqair conference of 1922 and by an agreement of 2 December 1922 'setting a straight-line border along the 29th parallel'; the Iraq frontier is 'not defined' on the pages opened and the Yemeni frontier was fixed only after 1934.

sources.title: Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd

sources.title: Unification of Saudi Arabia

sources.title: Saudi-Yemeni war (1934)
sources.note: Added by the reviewer (me-10-h): Asir's assent to Saudi suzerainty in 1926 and incorporation in 1930; Najran captured by the Saudis on 21 April 1934; Treaty of Taif 14 June 1934.

notes:
The Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd is the same state as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia from 23 September 1932 (a change of name with no territory moved): Cliopatria keeps this row through 1935 and starts its Saudi row only in 1936, while the kingdom-of-saudi-arabia dossier (group part i) starts on 23 September 1932 and has its own keyframe for 1932-1935 on this row's 1932 shape. This dossier therefore ends in September 1932; the colour agent may want one colour for both. The 1926-1931 shape is reviewed as Cliopatria has it; the 1932 shape is adjusted to the 1926 shape (Najran was not Saudi before April 1934).

Open points within the 2-page budget: the pages say nothing about the 1925 Aqaba and Ma'an transfer to Transjordan (kingdom-of-hejaz dossier), the 1926 Asir suzerainty (asir dossier), Najran (the Saudi-Yemeni war page, opened in the repair round, dates its capture to 21 April 1934 and the cession to the Treaty of Taif of 14 June 1934, after this state's life, so the former 1932 gain from north-yemen was deleted; kingdom-of-saudi-arabia /ledger/4 holds the 1934 gain), the Kuwait neutral zone, the Iraq neutral zone of 1922 and the Hadda and Bahra treaties of 1925, the Hijaz railway, or the Qatar frontier. The Kingdom page's infobox is partly garbled (the establishment date and capital) and gives no area. The former 1932 gain from north-yemen was removed after review; north-yemen's 1932 loss event (a duplicate of its 1934 loss) and the kingdom-of-saudi-arabia 1932-1935 keyframe are for their authors to correct. Gazetteer: 'Asir' and 'Najran' (admin1) resolve; 'Jabal Shammar' is not a region name (the war entry has no zone).
